summary: New box Infinitiv: example for sense 1 in Infinitiv (JTM 1.1/60)

data.turoyo: W ag gawze ste, u ḥa d soyəm d gawze, ktowər ag gawze, hawo ste kmatranne, lašan d lə məqrofi bu xrozo, w kxurzənne, ksaymənne ʕəliqe rabe aw naʕime <...>
data.translation: Die Walnüsse, wenn jemand (Süßwurst) von Walnüssen machen möchte, dann knackt er die Walnüsse, doch die muss man befeuchten, damit sie beim Auffädeln nicht auseinanderbrechen. Man fädelt sie auf und macht große oder kleine Girlanden davon.

rationale: First Infinitiv xrozo, in bu xrozo; the walnut preparation gives the activity object and contrasts with finite kxurzənne.

summary: New box Imperativ: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (JTM 4.4/15)

data.turoyo: xraz i xaraze ḥeta b qḏolux, w məd lu gurno ḥete b qarʕux!
data.translation: Lege dir die Brunneneinfassung als Krause um den Hals und nimm den Trog und setze ihn dir auf den Kopf!

rationale: First Imperativ xraz; well-surround as unusually large ring extends threading/insertion without a new sense.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/128)

data.turoyo: Ŭ dobaʕ̥ g̊sōm mena kəmmínanne ʕoliqe, hən kəmmi ʕqude, hániste xurziwa, dəmmina bu+ḥuṭo, luze aw gawze.
data.translation: And if he were to want to make from it what we call walnut rope, some say walnut knots, these ones they would thread, let’s say with a needle, almonds or walnuts.

rationale: First Infectum-wa threading context. Preserve edition needle, flag the lexical mismatch with ḥuṭo.

summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 3 in Part. Pass. (Jan 2.4/721)

data.turoyo: ʕAskar gabayna, m Arayli amṭanwolan ḥabuše xrize bu ḥuṭo.
data.translation: As soldiers, they used to bring us apples from Ereğli, strung on a thread.

rationale: First Part. Pass. example and new Detransitive result sense 3; attributive plural affected theme.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 2.31/5014)

data.turoyo: Məbliwo karəwono, ya ḥatro, xurziwola bi arʕo bayn daz zadone, quṭriwo aʕla čike d Ṣiboro, <...>
data.translation: They would take a plough beam or a stick, thrust it into the ground among the crops, tie a little Annunciation thread to it, <...>

rationale: Thin Infectum-wa cell; insertion rather than food threading, with overt site and object suffix.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 3.55/1566)

data.turoyo: šəqlanwo tralfo-tloṯalfo gawze, turowanalle w xərzowaynalle, <...>
data.translation: they bought two thousand or three thousand walnuts. I cracked them and threaded them. <...>

rationale: Thin Infectum-wa cell and distinct female first-person form; copied edition person shifts are flagged rather than repaired.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) eindringen, sich hineindrängen
rationale: Makes the already exemplified self-directed motion meaning explicit, without renumbering any existing Detransitive sense.

summary: New sense 2: (Detrans.; mit b-) in eine Falle geraten

data.gloss: (Detrans.; mit b-) in eine Falle geraten

rationale: Two trap contexts show accidental affected entry/entrapment, contrasting with the controlled incursion of sense 1. No particular piercing mechanism is asserted.

summary: New sense 3: (Detrans.) aufgefädelt sein
rationale: Apples xrize bu ḥuṭo are strung themes. This result differs from the self-motion and trap senses 1–2 added in round 1; one clear attributive plural attestation.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.1/59)

data.turoyo: al luze iḏiʕe ne, kturənne, kmawfəqi al lebaṯṯe, kxurzənne xəd u mede d ubʕi, rabe aw d ubʕi naʕime, ḥa su ḥreno, ḥa su ḥreno bi mḥaṭo w ḥuṭo.
data.translation: Die Mandeln sind ja bekannt, man knackt sie und nimmt die Mandelkerne heraus, und dann fädelt man sie auf, wie man möchte, große oder kleine (Süßwürste), eine (Mandel) neben der anderen, mit Nadel und Faden.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; almonds with needle and thread supply an explicit threading frame.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.1/60)

data.turoyo: W ag gawze ste, u ḥa d soyəm d gawze, ktowər ag gawze, hawo ste kmatranne, lašan d lə məqrofi bu xrozo, w kxurzənne, ksaymənne ʕəliqe rabe aw naʕime <...>
data.translation: Die Walnüsse, wenn jemand (Süßwurst) von Walnüssen machen möchte, dann knackt er die Walnüsse, doch die muss man befeuchten, damit sie beim Auffädeln nicht auseinanderbrechen. Man fädelt sie auf und macht große oder kleine Girlanden davon.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; finite threading in the same passage selected for the new Infinitiv, with distinct box placement.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 12/19)

data.turoyo: W xrəzle u ḥuṭo b ṣawʕe di žənəke, hiya daməxto.
data.translation: Darauf tat dieser den Faden wieder an den Finger der Frau, welche noch schlief.

rationale: Fourth Preterit context: thread placed on a finger, distinct from needle penetration; actor remains unasserted.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 12/22)

data.turoyo: mšaḥalle u šafuḏo w xrəzle bayn ad dafoṯo, huwe šaḥino. čik bi žənəke. Əmmo: “Uff, yaqiḏono.”
data.translation: Er aber machte das Eisen heiss und steckte es zwischen den Brettern durch. Es war heiss; als es in die Frau drang, schrie sie: »Uff! ich bin verbrannt!«

rationale: Fifth Preterit example: implicit spit as moved object, boards as path; translation cut retains edition wording.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 19/24)

data.turoyo: Azza i pire, xrizo lalġul. Omər: “Layko gəzzəx tamo?” Əmmo: “Əno harke kəzzi l gaba. At tarʕe ʕaṣye ne” – i pire kəmmo.
data.translation: Die Alte ging, aber in's Innere der Höle hinein. »Wohin gehst du da?« rief er. »Ich gehe hier zu ihr, die Tore sind ja verschlossen«.

rationale: Thin Detransitive cell; female self-directed entry into a space rather than an army.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 36/65)

data.turoyo: Ḥzalle l Aḥmad, mayəṯ aʕlayye, mḥalaqle ruḥe aʕlayye, xrizi bayn am maye, mḥalaqle ruḥe aʕlayye, mḏ̣ayəʕ Aḥmad.
data.translation: als Aḥmed sie erblickte, starb er fast vor Entzücken. Er wollte sich auf sie stürzen, aber sie gingen zurück in's Wasser. Da stürzte er sich auf sie und verschwand.

rationale: Thin Detransitive cell; plural subjects slip into water, extending the existing motion sense rather than adding another sense.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (PrS 72/67)

data.turoyo: Xriz u dewo ba tre faḥe, i raġlo qamayto w i ḥarayto, kle u quzo w u taʕlo kəmfarǧi ʕal u dewo.
data.translation: der Wolf kam an ihn heran und tappte in zwei Fallen hinein, mit einem Vorderfuss und einem Hinterfuss; der Marder und der Fuchs sahen ihm ruhig zu.

rationale: New trapping construction with two traps and explicit affected legs; no impalement inference.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (PrS 81/88)

data.turoyo: Aṯi u dewo mədle lu laḥmo, xriz bu faḥo, ṭayər u laḥmo, axile lu taʕlo.
data.translation: Der Wolf kam, griff nach dem Brote und geriet in die Falle, das Brot flog aus derselben hinaus, und der Fuchs frass es auf

rationale: Second trapping context confirms involuntary entry into a trap and contrasts with controlled incursion.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (94/150)

data.turoyo: W aʕ ʕoliqe: hanək, m at tene kosaymənne. Hanək ste, koxərzənne w koġayṭənne tlaṯ, arbaʕ kore bi ḥawdal w bəṯr, hul d nəšfi. Hanək ste, xd a ḥrene, komaḥtənne b as sanduqe.
data.translation: Die Feigenwürste macht man aus Feigen. Man reiht sie ebenfalls auf einem faden auf, taucht sie drei, vier Mal in ḥaudal und läßt sie trocknen. Auch sie legt man wie die anderen in Kisten.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: fig-stringing alongside inherited walnuts and the new almond context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 2.4/581)

data.translation: Well, I slipped in, I squeezed in beside him.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Preterit 1 cell after round 1; clear 1sg self-motion with goal gabe.

summary: Active valency separates moved theme from insertion site: needle -o with l ṣawʕe, thread u ḥuṭo with b ṣawʕe, and implicit spit with bayn ad dafoṯo. Do not gloss the finger as the direct pierced object.

Detransitive qṭil-type forms mark self-directed movement as well as accidental trapping; no external agent or passive threading is required. Three proposals for motion/trapping are grouped into two meanings.
Infinitiv xrozo is an activity form in bu xrozo; unlike the ybl agent noun -ono, it transparently names the threading event.
Existing examples with null sense tags are preserved; all active examples belong to the single inherited sense 1. The existing Detransitive text exemplifies newly explicit Detransitive 1.
The inherited prs page/line and LuF page/verse citations differ from supplied text/verse citations; identical passage identity does not by itself warrant citation replacement.
The result description of apples supplies a new Part. Pass. cell and cannot be assigned to the self-motion gloss solely because both are Detransitive.
xurziwola has an inserted object and bi arʕo site; xrəzno has a moving subject and gabe goal. This valency contrast supports active versus Detransitive independently of the English wording.
The female speaker xərzowaynalle supplies a distinct Infectum-wa shape in walnut processing; preserve all vowels and suffixes. No root correction is made to the uncertain šrəzlile quotation.
MAC Ishaq Material culture/128: does bu+ḥuṭo mean with thread/string rather than the edition’s needle? Edition English is preserved.
PrS 12/19: who is the omitted actor? Neither the single verse nor German dieser secures the referent.
Do the trap examples specify wedging, piercing, or general entrapment? Current gloss deliberately records only getting into a trap.
Obtain checked translations of the Jan examples; English is machine output.
Jan 2.28/4631: verify šrəzlile against the recording/transcription and possible other roots. Without initial x evidence, the proposed figurative word-stringing use remains unassigned.
Jan 2.4/581: confirm xrəzno vocalism versus the xriz-type Detransitive paradigm; no silent normalization.
Confirm -wo/-la and -waynalle suffix analyses in Jan 2.31/5014 and 3.55/1566, especially the stick antecedent and feminine observer form.

The well surround extends the threaded object’s size; almonds/figs extend walnut threading. Neither adds a lexical sense. Active ruḥa insertion and Detransitive self-motion give alternative valency patterns.
Threading walnuts and thrusting a stick into the soil retain the inherited threading/insertion meaning. Round 1 already supplied Infectum-wa; only thin-cell support is new.
First-person self-insertion beside a person supports round-1 Detransitive motion 1 without a new sense.
